name: NEO Android development
postCreateCommand: yes | sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null && sdkmanager 'platforms;android-36' 'build-tools;36.1.0' 'platform-tools' && mkdir -p "$HOME/.android" && if [ ! -f "$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" ]; then keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore "$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey -keypass android -dname 'CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US' -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000; fi
